headline: A season of ordinary closeness and finding your stride
reflection: Your picture of a full life with close friends seems to be taking shape in ordinary plans: swimming with Jordan and Ana until the sun went down, then later gathering around a messy kitchen and a full table. Those moments hold different kinds of togetherness, both unhurried and lively. At the same time, the crowded work stretch seems to have pulled you away from running, and the strain showed up in your patience with your roommate. When you returned, slow and happy, you noticed the clarity you’d missed. Maybe this season is showing you how connection and health can both be part of a full life—not perfectly balanced every week, but present in the story you’re building.
